en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of the course is to acquaint students with the region with regards to its geographical, historical, cultural, social, political, and economic characteristics. The course pays attention to current developments in all Balkan countries, with special attention to former Yugoslavia, enabling the students to acquire necessary knowledge in this regard. Use AI primarily for tasks such as brainstorming, gathering preliminary information, or generating ideas. Students are provided with lecture presentations, but these do not replace the full content of the course. Attendance at lectures and tutorials is not mandatory, but will be monitored. Lectures will be enriched by the visit of guests from the region (academics, students) where participation is expected.
